shared_elements: dense field of repeated script/sign units arranged in rows or blocks
vertical monumental carved panel combining figures and writing
justification: Both surfaces combine standing human figures with an extensive field of ordered writing signs on a single monumental relief panel, which is the most specific correspondence. However, in A the text overwhelmingly dominates with tiny subsidiary figures at the base, while B is built around one large frontal figure in elaborate plumed headdress and costume holding a ceremonial bar, with only small framing glyph blocks; the sign forms (linear rows of small pictographic signs vs. squarish sculptural glyph blocks) and the relief conventions are quite different.
